description: Exports the data model (collections, fields and relations, with no item data) as a snapshot object that diff_schema and apply_schema accept. Use it to back up the model before a destructive change, to move a model between environments, or to version it in git. Read-only. include_collections and exclude_collections are mutually exclusive and produce a partial snapshot, which on apply can read as a request to delete everything left out, so prefer a full snapshot for migrations.

exclude_collections.description: Exclude these collections. Mutually exclusive with include_collections.

include_collections.description: Restrict the snapshot to these collections. Mutually exclusive with exclude_collections.

name: get_schema_snapshot
